releaseNotes: Fixed: the sidebar's hide toggle became unreachable once hidden (moved to the top bar). Fixed: Save button wasn't aligned with Edit/Preview/Export. Fixed: switching flyers didn't always update the goes-live dates shown. Cell popup menu is now a single condensed icon-only row (Replace/clear/remove-box) that opens above the box instead of beside it; text is centered by default instead of a manual toggle.
